description_good_justification: The README opens with what the site is, a 2D map of the Milky Way's centre, nearby stars and the solar system moving in real time, and what it lets you do: https://github.com/phun-ky/site-interstellar/blob/main/README.md#about
interact_justification: The README links the live site and explains how to run it; the contributing guide explains how to ask questions, report bugs (GitHub issues) and contribute: https://github.com/phun-ky/site-interstellar/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#i-have-a-question
contribution_justification: The contribution process (set up, tests, signed-off commits, pull requests and the required checks): https://github.com/phun-ky/site-interstellar/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#your-first-code-contribution
contribution_requirements_justification: Requirements for contributions, including the commit style, tests with every change, the coverage floor, performance budgets and the DCO: https://github.com/phun-ky/site-interstellar/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#your-first-code-contribution
documentation_basics_justification: The README describes the site, links it, and shows how to run, build and test it; the contributing guide describes every script, the tests, commits, pull requests and deploys: https://github.com/phun-ky/site-interstellar/blob/main/README.md#development
documentation_interface_justification: The site's interface is the map and its controls. The README lists what they do (pan, zoom, lock on a body, the layer toggles, hold, speed and reset), and every control is labelled on the page: https://github.com/phun-ky/site-interstellar/blob/main/README.md#about
sites_https_justification: The repository and the site are served over HTTPS; GitHub Pages enforces HTTPS for the site, and HTTP redirects to it: https://github.com/phun-ky/site-interstellar and https://phun-ky.net/site-interstellar/
discussion_justification: GitHub issues and pull requests are searchable, addressable by URL and open to anyone with a GitHub account: https://github.com/phun-ky/site-interstellar/issues
english_justification: All documentation is in English, and reports and comments in English are accepted.
maintained_justification: The project is actively maintained: more than 20 pull requests were merged and deployed in November 2026: https://github.com/phun-ky/site-interstellar/pulls?q=is%3Apr+is%3Amerged
repo_track_justification: Git records who changed what and when: https://github.com/phun-ky/site-interstellar/commits/main
repo_interim_justification: Every change is a public commit and pull request; there are no separate releases, main is what is deployed.
version_unique_justification: The site is continuously delivered: every merge to main is deployed, and each deployed version is identified by its git commit ID, which GitHub records for every GitHub Pages deployment: https://github.com/phun-ky/site-interstellar/deployments
version_semver_justification: The site doesn't use version numbers: it is a single website, continuously delivered, so each deployed version is identified by its git commit instead. As the criterion's rationale notes, SemVer adds little for such a site.
version_tags_justification: Each deployed version is a commit on main, identified in git; GitHub records each GitHub Pages deployment against that commit: https://github.com/phun-ky/site-interstellar/deployments
release_notes_justification: The site is a single website, not reused in multiple places, and is continuously delivered: every merge to main is deployed. Each change is described in its pull request: https://github.com/phun-ky/site-interstellar/pulls?q=is%3Apr+is%3Amerged
release_notes_vulns_justification: Everyone always runs the latest version: the site is a single website, continuously delivered, so there are no versions to choose between or update. A fixed vulnerability would be described in a GitHub security advisory.
report_responses_justification: No one outside the project has filed a bug report in the last 12 months, so none is unanswered. Reports are answered in their GitHub issue.
enhancement_responses_justification: No one outside the project has filed an enhancement request in the last 12 months, so none is unanswered. Requests are answered in their GitHub issue.
report_archive_justification: All issues and pull requests stay public and searchable on GitHub: https://github.com/phun-ky/site-interstellar/issues?q=is%3Aissue
vulnerability_report_private_justificati: Private reports through GitHub private vulnerability reporting, which is enabled, or by email: https://github.com/phun-ky/site-interstellar/blob/main/SECURITY.md#reporting-a-vulnerability
vulnerability_report_response_justificat: No vulnerability has been reported in the last 6 months. Reports are acknowledged within 7 days: https://github.com/phun-ky/site-interstellar/blob/main/SECURITY.md#how-reports-are-handled
build_justification: npm run build builds the site with Vite into dist/, adding the Content Security Policy and the page metadata: https://github.com/phun-ky/site-interstellar/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#scripts
build_common_tools_justification: npm, Vite and the TypeScript compiler.
build_floss_tools_justification: npm, Node.js, Vite and TypeScript are all FLOSS.
test_justification: Unit tests with Node's test runner (npm test), Playwright tests of the built site in Google Chrome (npm run test:e2e), and performance budgets on a throttled phone (npm run test:performance): https://github.com/phun-ky/site-interstellar/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#tests
test_invocation_justification: npm test, the standard way to run tests in an npm project; npm run test:e2e and npm run test:performance for the checks of the built site.
test_most_justification: The unit tests cover 94% of lines, 94% of branches and 95% of functions, and npm run test:coverage fails below 89% of lines, 88% of branches or 95% of functions, and the coverage is uploaded to Codecov from CI. The Playwright tests cover the map with mouse, keyboard and touch, on wide and narrow screens, and the 404 page: https://github.com/phun-ky/site-interstellar/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#tests
test_continuous_integration_justificatio: The Check workflow lints, checks formatting, type-checks, runs the unit tests with coverage, builds and validates the HTML, and runs the end-to-end tests and performance budgets, on every pull request and, through the Deploy workflow, before every deploy from main: https://github.com/phun-ky/site-interstellar/blob/main/.github/workflows/check.yml
test_policy_justification: New code comes with its tests, and a fix with a test that fails without it: https://github.com/phun-ky/site-interstellar/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#tests
tests_are_added_justification: Recent changes came with tests: touch pan and pinch zoom (#89) with unit and touch tests, the narrow screen layout (#88), the header (#87) and the page metadata (#84) with end-to-end tests, and the moons (#86) and asteroids (#81) fixes with tests that failed before them.
tests_documented_added_justification: The tests policy is part of the instructions for contributing code: https://github.com/phun-ky/site-interstellar/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#tests
warnings_justification: TypeScript in strict mode, ESLint (typescript-eslint, stylistic, Markdown and import rules) on every file, Markdown included, and html-validate on the built pages.
warnings_fixed_justification: Lint has no errors and no warnings, TypeScript has no errors, and the built HTML validates; CI fails on any of them.
warnings_strict_justification: TypeScript runs with strict: true, and CI runs ESLint with --max-warnings=0, so a warning fails the Check workflow.
know_secure_design_justification: The maintainer knows how to design secure software. The principles applied: no server, accounts or stored data; nothing read from the URL, storage or network; a Content Security Policy that allows only the site's own scripts, styles, images and fonts; nothing loaded from other hosts; least-privilege CI tokens, pinned Actions, and deploys only of commits that passed the checks. What the site guarantees and does not: https://github.com/phun-ky/site-interstellar/blob/main/SECURITY.md#security-expectations
know_common_errors_justification: The maintainer knows the common errors for this kind of software: cross-site scripting (body facts are escaped before they are shown, and the Content Security Policy allows no inline scripts or styles), loading from other hosts (blocked by the policy and checked in the end-to-end tests), framing (a limit of a <meta> policy, documented), and the supply chain (locked dependencies installed with npm ci, a 14-day update cooldown, dependency review and pinned Actions): https://github.com/phun-ky/site-interstellar/blob/main/SECURITY.md#dependencies
crypto_published_justification: The site implements and calls no cryptography: it is static HTML, CSS and JavaScript that draw a map of space in the browser, with no accounts, secrets or server. HTTPS is provided by GitHub Pages. See the security expectations: https://github.com/phun-ky/site-interstellar/blob/main/SECURITY.md#security-expectations

HTTPS is provided by GitHub Pages. See the security expectations: https://github.com/phun-ky/site-interstellar/blob/main/SECURITY.md#security-expectations
crypto_random_justification: The site generates no keys, nonces or other security values. See the security expectations: https://github.com/phun-ky/site-interstellar/blob/main/SECURITY.md#security-expectations
delivery_mitm_justification: The site is served only over HTTPS by GitHub Pages, with HTTPS enforced, and deployed from GitHub Actions; the repository is served over HTTPS and SSH.
delivery_unsigned_justification: No hashes are fetched over HTTP; npm verifies the integrity hashes in package-lock.json against packages downloaded over HTTPS.
vulnerabilities_fixed_60_days_justificat: The site's runtime dependencies have no known vulnerabilities (npm audit --omit=dev). The two open advisories are in development dependencies pulled in by ESLint, published less than 60 days ago, and are handled as the security policy describes: https://github.com/phun-ky/site-interstellar/blob/main/SECURITY.md#dependencies
vulnerabilities_critical_fixed_justifica: No critical vulnerability has been found in the site or its runtime dependencies.
no_leaked_credentials_justification: No credentials are in the repository; the one secret, the Codecov upload token, is an encrypted GitHub Actions secret, and GitHub secret scanning with push protection is enabled: https://github.com/phun-ky/site-interstellar/blob/main/SECURITY.md#secrets
static_analysis_justification: CodeQL (GitHub default setup) analyses every pull request and push to main, for the TypeScript code and the workflows, and ESLint runs on every pull request.
static_analysis_common_vulnerabilities_j: CodeQL analyses the JavaScript and TypeScript code and the GitHub Actions workflows on every push to main and every pull request, and the ruleset on main blocks merging while it reports an error or a high or critical security alert: https://github.com/phun-ky/site-interstellar/blob/main/SECURITY.md#code-scanning
static_analysis_fixed_justification: CodeQL has no open alerts; the ruleset blocks merging with a high or critical one.
static_analysis_often_justification: On every pull request and every push to main.
dynamic_analysis_justification: An automated test suite with more than 80% branch coverage (92%) runs on every pull request and before every deploy, and the Playwright tests run the built site in Chrome with varied input: mouse, wheel, keyboard and touch, phone, tablet and wide viewports, device pixel ratios, axe accessibility checks and a throttled network and CPU: https://github.com/phun-ky/site-interstellar/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#tests
dynamic_analysis_unsafe_justification: All software is TypeScript on JavaScript runtimes, which are memory-safe; there is no C, C++ or other memory-unsafe code.
dynamic_analysis_enable_assertions_justi: The tests assert on every result, and the end-to-end tests fail on any console error, uncaught exception, failed request or Content Security Policy violation in the page; the build throws when the policy cannot be added correctly.
dynamic_analysis_fixed_justification: No medium or higher severity vulnerability has been found by the tests.
achieve_passing_justification: The project has the passing badge: https://www.bestpractices.dev/projects/16380
dco_justification: Every commit must be signed off under the Developer Certificate of Origin, checked on every pull request by the DCO app and required by the ruleset on main: https://github.com/phun-ky/site-interstellar/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#commits
governance_justification: The maintainer-led governance model and how decisions are made: https://github.com/phun-ky/site-interstellar/blob/main/GOVERNANCE.md
roles_responsibilities_justification: The maintainer and contributor roles and their responsibilities, and who holds them: https://github.com/phun-ky/site-interstellar/blob/main/GOVERNANCE.md#roles
access_continuity_justification: One maintainer holds the access to the repository and the phun-ky.net domain today. Deploys use no personal token and the code is GPL-3.0, but no second person holds access yet: https://github.com/phun-ky/site-interstellar/blob/main/GOVERNANCE.md#continuity
bus_factor_justification: The project has one maintainer, so the bus factor is 1: https://github.com/phun-ky/site-interstellar/graphs/contributors
documentation_roadmap_justification: What the project plans, would do later and will not do until November 2027, linking the issues: https://github.com/phun-ky/site-interstellar/blob/main/ROADMAP.md
documentation_architecture_justification: The page, the simulation loop, the features drawn on the canvas, the bundled data, the Content Security Policy and the tests: https://github.com/phun-ky/site-interstellar/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#architecture
documentation_security_justification: What visitors can and cannot rely on: https://github.com/phun-ky/site-interstellar/blob/main/SECURITY.md#security-expectations
documentation_quick_start_justification: Open the live site; nothing is installed. The README says how to pan, zoom, lock on a body, open its info and find any body: https://github.com/phun-ky/site-interstellar/blob/main/README.md#about
documentation_current_justification: The README, contributing guide, security policy and roadmap were brought up to date with the November 2026 overhaul and with the pull request for these answers. CI lints the Markdown with ESLint and checks that every file and heading linked from .bestpractices.json and security-insights.yml exists, and the Links workflow checks the external links every week.
documentation_achievements_justification: The README shows the OpenSSF Best Practices and Scorecard badges: https://github.com/phun-ky/site-interstellar/blob/main/README.md
accessibility_best_practices_justificati: The page has a skip link, landmarks, a text alternative for the canvas, labelled controls reached with Tab in order with visible focus, keys for the map, and no animated zoom with reduced motion. The end-to-end tests run axe (WCAG 2.0, 2.1 and 2.2 A and AA, and best practice) on load, with a body locked and its info open, and with the focus view open, and check the keyboard order and the skip link: https://github.com/phun-ky/site-interstellar/blob/main/tests/e2e/accessibility.spec.ts
internationalization_justification: The site is in English only. Its text is in the HTML page and the TypeScript that builds the interface, not in message files, so translating it would mean changing the code.
sites_password_security_justification: The project sites (GitHub and a static site on GitHub Pages) store no passwords for external users; the site has no accounts or sign in.
maintenance_or_update_justification: There is one version, the live site: every visitor gets the current one, so there is no older version to maintain or upgrade from: https://github.com/phun-ky/site-interstellar/blob/main/SECURITY.md#supported-versions
vulnerability_report_credit_justificatio: No vulnerabilities have been reported to the project in the last 12 months; the repository has no security advisories: https://github.com/phun-ky/site-interstellar/security/advisories
vulnerability_response_process_justifica: Reports are made privately through GitHub private vulnerability reporting or by email. Acknowledgement within 7 days, assessment, a fix in a private GitHub security advisory, disclosure once the fix is live, and credit: https://github.com/phun-ky/site-interstellar/blob/main/SECURITY.md#how-reports-are-handled
coding_standards_justification: Code follows the project ESLint configuration (eslint-config-phun-ky), Prettier and TypeScript in strict mode, and must pass npm run lint, npm run format:check and npm run typecheck: https://github.com/phun-ky/site-interstellar/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#coding-style
coding_standards_enforced_justification: The Check workflow runs ESLint with no warnings allowed, Prettier and the TypeScript compiler in strict mode on every pull request, and the ruleset on main requires its check job to pass before merging.
build_standard_variables_justification: No native binaries are built; Vite compiles TypeScript and CSS into the static site.
build_preserve_debug_justification: The build keeps source maps (build.sourcemap in vite.config.mjs), deployed next to the minified scripts, so stack traces and debuggers map to the original TypeScript.
build_non_recursive_justification: npm run build runs vite build once, with one configuration that builds both pages; nothing builds recursively.
build_repeatable_justification: Dependencies are locked in package-lock.json and installed with npm ci. Building the same commit twice gives identical output, and a local build of main (60cca9c) matched the HTML, CSS, JavaScript and source map files deployed to GitHub Pages byte for byte.
installation_common_justification: The site is a website: nothing is installed or uninstalled. Visitors open it in a browser.
installation_standard_variables_justific: The site is a website: nothing is installed, so there are no installation locations to honour.
installation_development_quick_justifica: git clone, npm ci and npm run dev give the full development environment, and npm test and npm run test:e2e run the checks: https://github.com/phun-ky/site-interstellar/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#set-up
external_dependencies_justification: The runtime dependencies (four @interstellar-tools packages and the IBM Plex Sans Condensed font) and the development dependencies are listed in package.json and locked in package-lock.json: https://github.com/phun-ky/site-interstellar/blob/main/SECURITY.md#dependencies
dependency_monitoring_justification: Dependabot checks npm dependencies weekly and opens security updates at once, and dependency review checks every pull request: https://github.com/phun-ky/site-interstellar/blob/main/SECURITY.md#dependencies
updateable_reused_components_justificati: Dependencies, the font included, come from npm through package.json and the lockfile, and Dependabot opens update pull requests. No third-party code is copied into the repository.
interfaces_current_justification: The code uses current interfaces: ES modules, the Canvas 2D API with requestAnimationFrame, the Web Audio API, Vite 8, TypeScript in strict mode, Node 24 in CI, and current GitHub Actions pinned to commit SHAs.
automated_integration_testing_justificat: The Check workflow lints, type-checks, runs the unit tests with coverage, builds the site and validates its HTML, and runs the Playwright end-to-end tests and performance budgets against the built site in Chrome, on every pull request and before every deploy: https://github.com/phun-ky/site-interstellar/blob/main/.github/workflows/check.yml
regression_tests_added50_justification: 16 of the 20 fix commits since May 2026 came with tests. Two of the four without fixed the link check script and the release configuration rather than the site.
test_statement_coverage80_justification: Line coverage of the source (tests excluded), measured with Node built-in coverage on every CI run and uploaded to Codecov, is 94%. npm run test:coverage fails below 89% of lines, 88% of branches or 95% of functions: https://github.com/phun-ky/site-interstellar/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#tests
test_policy_mandated_justification: New code must come with tests that cover it, and a fix with a test that fails without it: https://github.com/phun-ky/site-interstellar/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#tests
implement_secure_design_justification: Secure design principles applied (economy of mechanism, fail-safe defaults, least privilege, complete mediation, open design, no dynamic code, minimal dependencies): https://github.com/phun-ky/site-interstellar/blob/main/ASSURANCE.md#secure-design-principles
crypto_algorithm_agility_justification: The site implements and calls no cryptography: it is static HTML, CSS and JavaScript that draw a map of space in the browser, with no accounts, secrets or server, and it makes no network requests beyond loading its own files. HTTPS and its certificates are GitHub Pages' and the browser's. See the security expectations: https://github.com/phun-ky/site-interstellar/blob/main/SECURITY.md#security-expectations

version_tags_signed_justification: There are no releases and no tags: each deployed version is a commit on main. Commits are not signed.

assurance_case_justification: What is protected, the threat model, trust boundaries, secure design principles, the common weaknesses countered and the known gaps: https://github.com/phun-ky/site-interstellar/blob/main/ASSURANCE.md
osps_ac_01_01_justification: The maintainer, the only person with access, uses two-factor authentication on GitHub, which GitHub requires for code contributors. Anyone given access later must use it too: https://github.com/phun-ky/site-interstellar/blob/main/GOVERNANCE.md#becoming-a-maintainer
osps_ac_02_01_justification: GitHub requires a role to be chosen for every collaborator invited to the repository, and the governance requires the lowest role that fits: https://github.com/phun-ky/site-interstellar/blob/main/GOVERNANCE.md#becoming-a-maintainer
osps_ac_03_01_justification: The ruleset on main requires changes to arrive through a pull request with passing checks; only the maintainer, as administrator, can bypass it: https://github.com/phun-ky/site-interstellar/blob/main/.github/rulesets/main-merge-rules.json
osps_ac_03_02_justification: A separate ruleset on main, with no bypass, blocks deleting the branch and force pushes: https://github.com/phun-ky/site-interstellar/blob/main/.github/rulesets/main-protect-history.json
osps_br_01_01_justification: No workflow interpolates untrusted metadata, such as pull request titles or branch names, into a script; the commit message check gets the pull request's commit SHAs through environment variables: https://github.com/phun-ky/site-interstellar/blob/main/.github/workflows/check.yml
osps_br_01_03_justification: Pull requests run on the pull_request event, where forks get no secrets; no workflow runs on pull_request_target. The site deploys only from main, after a merge.
osps_br_03_01_justification: All official channels use HTTPS: the GitHub repository and the site at https://phun-ky.net/site-interstellar/, where GitHub Pages enforces HTTPS.
osps_br_03_02_justification: The site, the only thing distributed, is served only over HTTPS by GitHub Pages, and HTTP redirects to it: https://phun-ky.net/site-interstellar/
osps_br_07_01_justification: GitHub secret scanning with push protection is enabled and blocks commits that contain secrets; secrets are kept only in GitHub Actions secrets: https://github.com/phun-ky/site-interstellar/blob/main/SECURITY.md#secrets
osps_do_01_01_justification: How to use the map: panning, zooming, locking on a body, its info, the views and Bodies: https://github.com/phun-ky/site-interstellar/blob/main/README.md#about
osps_do_02_01_justification: How to report a bug, with an issue template: https://github.com/phun-ky/site-interstellar/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#reporting-bugs
osps_gv_02_01_justification: Proposed changes and usage problems are discussed in public GitHub issues and pull requests: https://github.com/phun-ky/site-interstellar/issues
osps_le_02_01_justification: The source code is under the GPL-3.0, which is OSI-approved: https://github.com/phun-ky/site-interstellar/blob/main/LICENSE
osps_le_02_02_justification: The deployed site is under the GPL-3.0, which is OSI-approved; the IBM Plex Sans Condensed font it serves is under the SIL Open Font License 1.1, also OSI-approved. osps_le_03_01_justification: The licence is in the LICENSE file at the repository root: https://github.com/phun-ky/site-interstellar/blob/main/LICENSE
osps_le_03_02_justification: Each deployed version is a commit on main, whose source includes the LICENSE file; the deployed JavaScript starts with the GPL-3.0 notice, and the font files carry their copyright and the Open Font License in their metadata: https://github.com/phun-ky/site-interstellar/blob/main/vite.config.mjs
osps_qa_01_02_justification: The full git history, with authors and dates, is public: https://github.com/phun-ky/site-interstellar/commits/main
osps_qa_02_01_justification: The runtime and development dependencies are listed in package.json, with every version locked in package-lock.json: https://github.com/phun-ky/site-interstellar/blob/main/package.json
osps_qa_04_01_justification: The project has a single repository.
osps_qa_05_01_justification: No generated executables are committed: the build output (dist) is ignored, and the site is built in CI.
osps_qa_05_02_justification: The only binary files are images (the icons, the body images and the social card) and the background sound, no executables. The sound loop is made from media/ambience.wav by a script in the repository: https://github.com/phun-ky/site-interstellar/blob/main/scripts/make-ambience-loop.mjs
osps_vm_02_01_justification: Security contacts (email and GitHub private vulnerability reporting): https://github.com/phun-ky/site-interstellar/blob/main/SECURITY.md#reporting-a-vulnerability
osps_ac_04_01_justification: Every workflow sets read-only permissions at the top level, and jobs ask only for what they need: https://github.com/phun-ky/site-interstellar/blob/main/.github/workflows/check.yml
osps_br_02_01_justification: The site is continuously delivered: each deployed version is identified by its git commit ID, which GitHub records for every GitHub Pages deployment: https://github.com/phun-ky/site-interstellar/deployments
osps_br_04_01_justification: Every deployment is a merge of one pull request, whose description says what changed and how to test it, and CHANGELOG.md lists what landed on main month by month; security fixes are described in GitHub security advisories: https://github.com/phun-ky/site-interstellar/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md
osps_br_05_01_justification: Dependencies are installed with npm ci from the lockfile, which checks their integrity hashes, in every pipeline, the Deploy workflow included: https://github.com/phun-ky/site-interstellar/blob/main/.github/workflows/deploy.yml
osps_br_06_01_justification: The site is not distributed as assets anyone downloads or installs: browsers load it from GitHub Pages over HTTPS, deployed only by the Deploy workflow from main: https://github.com/phun-ky/site-interstellar/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#deploys
osps_do_06_01_justification: How dependencies are chosen, obtained, tracked and fixed: https://github.com/phun-ky/site-interstellar/blob/main/SECURITY.md#dependencies
osps_gv_01_01_justification: Who has access to the repository, the site and its domain: https://github.com/phun-ky/site-interstellar/blob/main/GOVERNANCE.md#continuity
osps_gv_01_02_justification: The maintainer and contributor roles and their responsibilities: https://github.com/phun-ky/site-interstellar/blob/main/GOVERNANCE.md#roles
osps_gv_03_02_justification: Requirements for code contributions: set-up, coding style, tests, commits, sign-off and pull requests: https://github.com/phun-ky/site-interstellar/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#your-first-code-contribution
osps_le_01_01_justification: Every commit must carry a Developer Certificate of Origin sign-off, checked on every pull request by the DCO app and required by the ruleset on main: https://github.com/phun-ky/site-interstellar/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#commits
osps_qa_03_01_justification: The ruleset on main requires the status checks (check, dependency-review and DCO) and CodeQL results to pass before merging; only an administrator can bypass it: https://github.com/phun-ky/site-interstellar/blob/main/SECURITY.md#code-scanning
osps_qa_06_01_justification: The Check workflow builds the site and runs the unit tests and the Playwright tests on every pull request; its check job must pass before merging: https://github.com/phun-ky/site-interstellar/blob/main/.github/workflows/check.yml
osps_sa_01_01_justification: The architecture (the page, the simulation loop, the features drawn on the canvas, the bundled data, the Content Security Policy and the tests): https://github.com/phun-ky/site-interstellar/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#architecture
osps_sa_02_01_justification: The site's only external interface is the page itself, described in the README; it has no API and reads nothing from the URL, storage or the network: https://github.com/phun-ky/site-interstellar/blob/main/README.md#about
osps_sa_03_01_justification: The assurance case assesses the most likely and impactful security problems: https://github.com/phun-ky/site-interstellar/blob/main/ASSURANCE.md
osps_vm_01_01_justification: Coordinated disclosure, with acknowledgement within 7 days and a fix within 30 days for serious issues: https://github.com/phun-ky/site-interstellar/blob/main/SECURITY.md#how-reports-are-handled
osps_vm_03_01_justification: Private reporting through GitHub private vulnerability reporting or the security email: https://github.com/phun-ky/site-interstellar/blob/main/SECURITY.md#reporting-a-vulnerability
osps_vm_04_01_justification: Vulnerabilities are published as GitHub security advisories once the fix is live: https://github.com/phun-ky/site-interstellar/blob/main/SECURITY.md#how-reports-are-handled
osps_ac_04_02_justification: Each job declares only the permissions it needs: the deploy job pages: write and id-token: write, the Scorecard job security-events: write and id-token: write, and every other job read-only: https://github.com/phun-ky/site-interstellar/blob/main/.github/workflows/deploy.yml
osps_br_01_04_justification: The workflows take no manual inputs, and the only values from a pull request used in a script, its commit SHAs, are passed through environment variables: https://github.com/phun-ky/site-interstellar/blob/main/.github/workflows/check.yml
osps_br_02_02_justification: Each deployment is recorded by GitHub against its commit, and its Pages artifact is built from that commit in that run: https://github.com/phun-ky/site-interstellar/deployments
osps_br_07_02_justification: How secrets are stored, accessed and rotated: https://github.com/phun-ky/site-interstellar/blob/main/SECURITY.md#secrets

osps_do_03_02_justification: The site is not distributed as assets anyone downloads or installs: browsers load it from GitHub Pages over HTTPS, deployed only by the Deploy workflow from main: https://github.com/phun-ky/site-interstellar/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#deploys
osps_do_04_01_justification: Only main and the live site built from it are supported; a fix is live once merged and deployed: https://github.com/phun-ky/site-interstellar/blob/main/SECURITY.md#supported-versions
osps_do_05_01_justification: There are no versioned releases: only the latest main is supported, and older commits get no fixes: https://github.com/phun-ky/site-interstellar/blob/main/SECURITY.md#supported-versions
osps_gv_04_01_justification: Collaborators are reviewed, including two-factor authentication, before getting escalated permissions: https://github.com/phun-ky/site-interstellar/blob/main/GOVERNANCE.md#becoming-a-maintainer

osps_qa_04_02_justification: The project has a single repository, so there are no subprojects in other repositories.
osps_qa_06_02_justification: When and how the tests run, locally and in CI: https://github.com/phun-ky/site-interstellar/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#tests
osps_qa_06_03_justification: New code must come with tests that cover it, and a fix with a test that fails without it: https://github.com/phun-ky/site-interstellar/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#tests
osps_qa_07_01_justification: The project has one maintainer, so no non-author approval is possible yet. A review by a maintainer other than the author is required once there is a second maintainer: https://github.com/phun-ky/site-interstellar/blob/main/GOVERNANCE.md#becoming-a-maintainer
osps_sa_03_02_justification: Threat model, trust boundaries and attack surface: https://github.com/phun-ky/site-interstellar/blob/main/ASSURANCE.md#threat-model
osps_vm_04_02_justification: Vulnerabilities in dependencies that don't affect the site are recorded as OpenVEX statements: https://github.com/phun-ky/site-interstellar/blob/main/vex.openvex.json
osps_vm_05_01_justification: Thresholds for fixing vulnerability findings in dependencies, and the licences a dependency may have: https://github.com/phun-ky/site-interstellar/blob/main/SECURITY.md#dependencies
osps_vm_05_02_justification: What happens to dependency findings before a change is merged and before a deploy: https://github.com/phun-ky/site-interstellar/blob/main/SECURITY.md#dependencies
